title: Can I BEAT Kung Fu Chess?
summary: Kung Fu Chess vs the site AI (Intermediate then Advanced): real-time chess with no turns.
rules: Standard pieces and moves on 8x8, but no turns: either side may move any piece at any time.
After a piece moves it has a cooldown before it can move again (yellow highlight).
Pieces travel over time; a piece can be captured mid-move (inferred).
